resources.string: Skill is on the same scale as book difficulty and has two parts. Fluency comes from how fast you read books of known difficulty: a book of difficulty 50 read at 8,000 characters an hour counts as 50, twice as fast as 60; recent weeks count more, and reading a book again doesn\'t count (you remember it). Speed depends on your screen and settings, so compare it only with itself. Vocabulary comes from the words on the pages you have read in those books (pages flicked past or skipped don\'t count): words you looked up and haven\'t marked as learned count as unknown, all others as known. It is an estimate, a little high when you skip lookups.

Settings, progress, statistics and saved words in one file, for a new phone or a new install

A backup keeps your settings, reading progress, statistics, skill, saved words and milestones in one file, saved where you choose (nothing is sent anywhere). Books are not in it: after a restore, add them again (from your book server, or the same files) and their progress comes back with them.\n\nRestoring adds to what is on this phone; it never deletes anything.
Keep the file somewhere safe, away from this phone (your computer or cloud storage, say). To restore it, open Settings → Back up and restore → Restore.
